usedFor: Magicbricks captures property leads, and HubSpot receives each one as a record through “Create Contact” or “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Leads” in Magicbricks, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A captured lead becomes a HubSpot contact, the record that later follow-up attaches to.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot requires an email, so check each Magicbricks lead carries one.
